decision.note: S0010 release drift check: FastMediaSorter S4248 (commit 44c85a65a, 2026-10-25) adds scheduled phone-to-watch messages and their receipts for the sorter's scheduled operations. Tourist has no scheduled operations and no such message; the kit's Data Layer paths, listeners and notification ids are unchanged by it. Revisit if Tourist adopts scheduled watch messages.
S0015: mandatory BOOLEAN-OPTION 2.0 replaces the switch presentation with a leading checkbox. The existing boolean values, listeners and commit ownership are preserved.

S0015 review: source S4460 adds optional toolbar-title glyph attributes for sorter feature bars. Tourist declares no such title-icon attribute or feature inventory; retain its existing toolbar and contextual Help action. Revisit when Tourist adopts feature-title glyphs; back navigation behavior is unchanged.

S0018 owner decision 2026-10-27: Tourist adds confirmed Android screen pinning around the existing immersive bars, preserves pin ownership through rotation, and leaves pre-existing pins intact. FastMediaSorter retains its old immersive-only guard; its source is read-only here. This dated exception records the behaviour difference until the upstream session carries the fix; a future source hash change still requires review.

S0018 owner decision 2026-10-27: Tourist consumes BACK and arms the lamp only after Android screen-pinning consent; hardware exits release only lamp-owned pinning. Intentional source divergence recorded here: FastMediaSorter is read-only to this session and its matching fix must be carried there separately. Retain upstream hash tracking.

S0035 local addition, not in the source: the SOS mode row stacks into a column when the three one-line labels do not fit the line (font 2.0 cut Light only to 3 px). FastMediaSorter keeps the plain horizontal toggle group and has the same clipping; its source is read-only here, so the fix is carried there by its own session. Nothing upstream is left uncarried by it.

S0037 local divergence: Tourist collects TouristInfoViewModel.attitude in observeData and feeds TouristHeroTileManager.bindAttitude, so the GYROSCOPE box turns. The FastMediaSorter source ported with S4560 exposes the stream and the binder but its activity never collects it (checked 2026-11-13). Carry FastMediaSorter's own collector when it lands and drop this line.

S0020 local addition, not in the source: binds WearInteractiveStateRepository, the signal of the owner's ambient decision of 2026-11-08 in ObserveWearTouristDashboardUseCase. Nothing upstream is left uncarried by this; a later source change is carried around the binding, not over it.

S0020 local addition, not in the source: owner decision 2026-11-08, ambient is not an open screen. The use case subscribes the telemetry only while the watch is interactive, because a slept Wear OS screen stays in ambient with the Activity resumed and the lifecycle never releases the sensors. FastMediaSorter's watch has no interactive or ambient signal and the same behaviour. Nothing upstream is left uncarried by this; a later source change is carried around the gate, not over it.
